annotation.equivalence_rationale: All three responses preserve the same core evidence for the three criteria: they identify needed monitoring inputs (live/trend readings, missing-data pattern, supporting logs), they recognize that action/escalation depends on whether the drift persists or becomes clearer, and they keep the issue under observation while documenting it. None introduces a materially different escalation owner, safeguard, or operational commitment; the differences are mainly in wording and detail. Although C mentions the local team not reporting anything, this does not change the overall decision-relevant posture compared with A and B.
